adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /prints with limit=1, matching the pinned validator. Official list-prints has no required query; the validator always pages.

Native category is productivity: Intelliprint is a hybrid-mail print-and-post API. Source Productivity/Communication are not both in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist; Communication is not an allowlisted value.

Official Connection, developers FAQ, and Mailchimp integration specify Authorization: Bearer. Generated per-endpoint cURL examples and the pinned source send the raw API key without a Bearer prefix. Native uses Bearer {{apiKey}}. The upstream user-agent is not sent. Writes, field projection, and nested letter-status filters are omitted.

Returns raw Intelliprint JSON under data. Optional limit (1-1000), skip, sort_order, sort_field, and type use official query names. Repeated fields projection, testmode/confirmed booleans, reference, and nested letters.status filters are omitted.
id is a required nonempty path segment on GET /prints/{id}.
Returns raw Intelliprint JSON under data. Optional limit, skip, and team use official query names. Field projection is omitted.
Returns raw Intelliprint JSON under data. Optional limit and skip use official query names. Field projection is omitted.
POST /prints creates a letter or postcard job. File uploads are represented as content or template IDs rather than multipart binaries.
Official update is POST /prints/{id} for unconfirmed jobs.
DELETE /prints/{id} cancels an unconfirmed print job.
GET /backgrounds/{id} returns one reusable background.
POST /backgrounds accepts a base64 file object {content,name} plus optional name and team.
Official update is POST /backgrounds/{id}.
DELETE /backgrounds/{id} removes a reusable background.
GET /mailing_lists/{id} returns one mailing list.
POST /mailing_lists requires name and may include an initial recipients array.
Official update is POST /mailing_lists/{id}.
DELETE /mailing_lists/{id} removes a mailing list.
GET /mailing_lists/{mailing_list}/recipients lists stored recipients with optional limit/skip.
GET /mailing_lists/{mailing_list}/recipients/{id} returns one recipient.
POST /mailing_lists/{mailing_list}/recipients adds an address.
Official recipient update is POST /mailing_lists/{mailing_list}/recipients/{id}.
DELETE /mailing_lists/{mailing_list}/recipients/{id} removes a recipient.
